title: Engineering Manager
description:
Your mission

As Engineering Manager at Cosuno, you will lead a team of full stack engineers while staying deeply hands-on: you'll spend 60–80% of your time coding, reviewing, and shaping the architecture alongside your team. You are the kind of leader who elevates a team by example — writing code that sets the bar, and building an environment where great engineers do their best work.

Your mission might include:

  • Leading a team of full stack and AI/ML engineers: coaching, regular 1:1s, growth plans, and hiring — while shipping product yourself every week.

  • Owning the delivery and technical quality of your team's roadmap, working closely with your Product Manager to plan, de-risk, and execute.

  • Contributing hands-on across our TypeScript stack (React + Node), from designing features to reviewing pull requests and tackling the hard problems yourself.

  • Raising the team's technical bar through code reviews, architectural guidance, and best practices — including driving the adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Partnering with engineering leadership on team topology, processes, and the technical direction of our platform.

How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:

  • Agile & Fast-Paced: We practice trunk-based development with daily releases to get value into our users' hands quickly.

  • Quality by Default: We maintain a comprehensive Cypress E2E test suite and enforce strict typing, linting, and formatting rules to keep our codebase clean and maintainable.

  • DevOps Mindset: Our well-oiled CI/CD pipeline deploys to AWS via Kubernetes, with our entire infrastructure managed as code using Terraform.

  • Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive code reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.

Your profile

We're looking for a player-coach: a strong engineer who leads people without giving up the keyboard. You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Extensive experience (typically 7+ years) in software engineering, with a proven track record of delivering complex, scalable web applications.

  • Strong expertise in our core technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and the ability to reason about the entire stack, from the database to the browser — and you still use it daily.

  • Leadership experience — whether as an Engineering Manager or team lead with direct reports, or as a senior tech lead who has mentored engineers, led projects, and shaped how a team works.

  • A genuine desire to keep coding: this role is 60–80% hands-on by design, and that's what excites you about it.

  • A passion for growing people. You find joy in helping other engineers develop, in giving honest feedback, and in building a healthy, high-performing team.

  • Bonus, not required: a good understanding of building LLM-based applications or ML algorithms — your team includes AI/ML engineers, and being able to follow their work helps, though you won't need to be the expert.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Why us

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Why Cosuno?

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Du fühlst dich in einem Startup wohl, in dem Strukturen noch entstehen und du sie mitgestaltest

title: Senior Fullstack Developer – Business Automation (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir verantworten u.a. das zentrale CRM HubSpot, über das alle Prozesse unserer Wertschöpfungskette laufen. Interne Software-Produkte integrieren sich genauso in unsere CRM-Infrastruktur wie spezifische Apps, z.B. zur Terminbuchung bei einer Kundenanfrage. Der nächste Skalierungs-Schritt erfordert einen noch stärkeren Fokus auf technisches Enablement unserer eigenen Organisation sowie den Ausbau und die Verbesserung unseres eigenen technischen Verantwortungsbereichs.

Du übernimmst dabei eine gewachsene, produktive Automatisierungslandschaft: Ein Teil unserer Geschäftslogik läuft heute als Custom Code direkt in HubSpot-Workflows, ein Teil in eigenen Backend-Services. Beides gehört dir – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich diese Architektur entwickelt.

Softwareentwicklung

  • Entwicklung TypeScript-basierter Automatisierungen und Services entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette im HubSpot CRM

  • Entwicklung von HubSpot-Apps und UI Extensions (React) für unsere internen Teams – von CRM-Cards bis Workflow-Actions

  • Verwaltung von Scopes, Token-Rotation, App-Versionierung und Deployments (CI/CD)

Automatisierungen & Workflows

  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von Custom-Code-Automatisierungen, die als Teil von HubSpot-Workflows laufen – inklusive Pflege der Workflows selbst (Trigger, Enrollment-Kriterien, Fehlerbilder)

  • Bewusste Platzierung von Logik: Du entscheidest, was in einen Workflow gehört, was in Custom Code und was in einen Backend-Service – und migrierst Logik dorthin, wo sie testbar und wartbar ist

  • Analyse und Behebung von Incidents in der bestehenden Automatisierungslandschaft, inklusive Datenkorrekturen und Backfills per Skript

API- & Event-getriebene Architektur

  • Einsatz der HubSpot CRM APIs für Objekte, Assoziationen und Batch-Operationen

  • Nutzung von Webhooks & Subscriptions für Event-getriebene Synchronisation

  • Aufbau robuster Retry-, Error-Handling- und Monitoring-Mechanismen – inklusive bewusstem Umgang mit Rate-Limits und Datenvolumen

Datenmodellierung & CRM-Architektur

  • Definition von Objektbeziehungen, Ownership-Logiken und Lifecycle-Zuständen

  • Sicherstellung von Datenkonsistenz über mehrere Systeme hinweg

Integrationen & Plattform-Strategie

  • Technische Anbindung interner sowie externer Systeme (z.B. Abrechnung, Metering, Energie-Backends, eigener Tech Stack)

  • Aufbau sauberer Schnittstellen zwischen HubSpot und produktiven Kernsystemen

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der langfristigen CRM- & Integrationsarchitektur – inklusive der schrittweisen Verlagerung komplexer Geschäftslogik aus Workflows in testbare Backend-Services



Dein Profil

Software-Engineering

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen, mit klarem Schwerpunkt Backend

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript; solide React-Kenntnisse für unsere CRM-Cards und UI Extensions (NestJS ist ein Plus)

  • Erfahrung mit REST-APIs, asynchronen Systemen, Queues und Event-Verarbeitung

  • Verständnis für saubere API-Verträge, Versionierung und Testing – du weißt, wann ein Pattern hilft und wann es Zeremonie ist

Systemdenken: Automatisierung & Skalierung

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit API- und Event-getriebener Integration von SaaS-Plattformen (CRM, Billing o.Ä.) – praktische Erfahrung mit der HubSpot Developer Platform (Private/Public Apps, OAuth 2.0, Scopes, Webhooks, UI Extensions) ist ein starkes Plus

  • Erfahrung im Design skalierbarer CRM- und Integrationsarchitekturen; du kannst HubSpot sinnvoll in eine größere Systemlandschaft einbetten

  • Bewusstsein für sinnvolle Automatisierungen, Performance, Plattform-Limits und Datenvolumen

Arbeitsweise & Ownership

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Assistenten und verantwortest das Ergebnis: Du entscheidest, was du delegierst, und reviewst, was zurückkommt

  • Unvollständig definierte Tickets schrecken dich nicht ab: Du willst wissen, wer ein Feature nutzt und warum, klärst offene Punkte aktiv und sagst auch mal Nein zu Features, die sich nicht rechnen

  • Ownership-Mindset statt Ticket-Abarbeitung: Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen, gibst dein Wissen weiter und fühlst dich in Startup-Strukturen wohl

  • Teamorientiert und direkt in der Kommunikation; einen technischen Trade-off kannst du auch einer nicht-technischen Person aus Product, Operations oder Management erklären

  • Sprachen: Deutsch mindestens auf B2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift


Warum wir?

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Genieße maximale Flexibilität mit der Möglichkeit zur hybriden Arbeit in Hamburg - Dabei würden wir uns gerne 1-2 Tage im Office treffen, die restlichen kannst du remote arbeiten

  • Mobil unterwegs: Zuschuss zu Deutschlandticket oder Einzelfahrscheinen, plus Bikeleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung – günstig zum eigenen Wunschrad, 100% privat nutzbar.

  • Fit & gesund: Mit unserem Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss trainierst Du deutschlandweit in tausenden Studios und Kursen, von Yoga bis Klettern.

  • Vorsorge: Wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge – für Deine Zukunft nach metergrid.

  • Gemeinschaft: Regelmäßige departmentübergreifende Events an unseren Standorten bringen das ganze Team zusammen.

  • Gestaltungsfreiraum: Wir sind ein motiviertes Start-up-Team ohne Hierarchieebenen. Bei uns kannst Du Deine Ideen umsetzen und den Kurs aktiv mitbestimmen.

  • Wachstumschancen: Deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung ist uns wichtig – wir bieten Dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten, Dich in neue Richtungen zu entwickeln.

  • Sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Du arbeitest nicht nur für einen Job, sondern für eine Mission: die Energiewende. In fünf Jahren kannst Du stolz sagen, dass Du Teil davon warst!

  • Schnelle Lernkurve und Eigenverantwortung: Von Tag 1 an bist Du mitten im Geschehen. Wir setzen auf Dich und Deine Fähigkeiten und unterstützen Dich in Deiner Entwicklung.

title: Full-stack Engineer - Creative Agents
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team where engineers own complete problems across the full stack: frontend, backend, agent architecture and infrastructure. You should be equally comfortable building a user-facing feature, designing the services behind it, and deploying and operating the system in production. You will combine strong engineering with product judgement, taking ideas from early prototypes through to reliable features and using real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building complete agent-powered features, from frontend interfaces and application state to backend services, APIs and data storage.

  • Developing agent capabilities and integrations, including model orchestration, creative tools and reliable asynchronous workflows for audio, image and video generation.

  • Building and operating the infrastructure behind these features, improving quality, performance, scalability and security through evaluations, monitoring and testing.

  • Owning a problem area from discovery and prototyping to deployment and ongoing operation, working closely with product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving a live product, with room to experiment and directly influence the product's direction.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong engineering skills across both frontend and backend, with a track record of independently building complete production applications.

  • Confidence designing user interfaces, backend services, APIs and data models, and understanding how these components work together as a system.

  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, asynchronous processing, testing and observability, with the ability to debug and resolve problems across the full stack.

  • Evidence of end-to-end ownership, strong product judgement and clear communication, taking ambiguous problems from technical design through to shipping and ongoing operation.

You should be excited about creative agents and comfortable learning quickly as models, tools and user needs evolve.

Hands-on experience building production agents, evaluations, MCP integrations, creative editors or multimodal products would be particularly valuable, as would experience building in a small, fast-moving team.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Nutze deine Kreativität und dein Talent zur Problemlösung, um innovative Softwarelösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln
  • Als Teamplayer arbeitest du dabei in crossfunktionalen und interdisziplinären Teams und begleitest den kompletten Softwareentwicklungsprozess – von der Idee bis zum Release

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind für dich selbstverständlich


Was wir dir bieten

title: Senior Solution Consultant (Pre-Sales) - DACH
description:
AMPECO is one of the most innovative companies in the area of electric vehicle charging infrastructure – an industry that aims to change the world by making charging easier for everyone. As electric vehicles (EVs) are bringing in a transformation of our transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of a grand revolution and we’re just getting started.

Our product – the AMPECO EV Charging Platform is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their electric vehicle charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. It’s already in use by companies in more than 70 countries — across North and South America, Europe, Africa, Asia and Australia.

Our team is highly motivated, capable, and committed to our mission — and our growth is backed by world-class investors, including BMW i Ventures, the mobility-focused venture-capital arm of the BMW Group. We are looking to expand the team with like-minded capable people, eager to give, learn and grow together with us.

About the role

AMPECO is expanding across the DACH region, and we’re looking for a Germany-based Senior Solution Consultant - responsible for pre-sales across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland - to help drive that growth. This is a senior, individual-contributor role for someone who combines deep product and industry expertise with the interpersonal range to win the confidence of technical and business stakeholders alike.

You will be the solutioning counterpart to our DACH Business Development Manager - the two of you working as a close-knit team on the region’s most important opportunities. While the BDM leads the commercial relationship, you own the solution end to end: mapping each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s platform, leading demonstrations and Proof-of-Concept engagements, owning bid management for DACH opportunities — from RFx and tenders through to the supporting business case — and making the complex feel clear for everyone in the room.

You won’t be doing this alone. You’ll be enabled by an established Solution Consulting team, with proven tools, practices, and methodologies behind you — so you can put your energy into the deals in front of you. AMPECO already powers some of the most prominent Charge Point Operators in the DACH region and is in active conversations with many of the rest, so you’ll be joining at a moment of real momentum and clear opportunity to expand. As we continue to grow across Germany and the wider region, the impact you make here will be significant — with room to grow alongside it.

If you thrive in fast-paced, complex enterprise environments, enjoy working with highly driven teams, and want to play a pivotal role in the energy transition in one of Europe’s most important EV markets, this role is for you.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of AMPECO’s platform and the e-mobility industry, with a strong grasp of the DACH market and its requirements;

  • Act as the solutioning lead on strategic DACH opportunities, working hand in hand with the DACH Business Development Manager to map each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s capabilities;

  • Drive Proof-of-Concept engagements with prospective clients, ensuring the business drivers are sound, relevant, and build a compelling case to advance the opportunity;

  • Design and deliver effective demonstrations that connect AMPECO’s solution advantages to prospects’ business and technical requirements;

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the key stakeholders involved in DACH deals, becoming a credible advisor throughout the sales cycle;

  • Take an active advisory role during sales cycles, bringing solution expertise and industry best practices to the team;

  • Own bid management for DACH opportunities — taking end-to-end responsibility for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and tenders, from structuring and writing the response to coordinating input across teams and managing deadlines;

  • Represent AMPECO at industry events across the region and stay close to market trends, the competitive landscape, and evolving customer needs;

  • Travel across the DACH region as needed for customer engagements, workshops, and events.


    • Your Profile

  • 6+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a pre-sales, solution consulting, or similar sales-focused role within enterprise or B2B software;

  • Native-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written — you will work with German-speaking enterprise customers daily;

  • Strong pre-sales execution skills: solution design, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concepts, and bid / RFx management;

  • Tech-savvy and a fast learner on technical topics — comfortable holding technical conversations and explaining how the platform works, without needing to be a deeply technical specialist or engineer;

  • A confident communicator, able to build rapport and credibility with senior business and technical stakeholders and to present complex topics clearly;

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges and shape solutions for evolving business models;

  • Strong business acumen — able to articulate customer value and connect AMPECO’s platform to strategic outcomes;

  • Based in Germany, self-driven and well-organised, and comfortable operating effectively in a remote, distributed team across the DACH region;

  • Naturally curious, with a genuine interest in continuously learning about the product and the industry;

  • A collaborative team player who works seamlessly with Sales, Product, and other specialists;

  • Motivated to build a long-term career in the e-mobility sector.


    • Considered an advantage

  • Domain knowledge in mobility, energy, or a related sector;

  • Familiarity with EV charging technology and standards such as OCPP, OCPI, or ISO 15118;

  • Experience working in a SaaS or PaaS environment with long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles;

  • Background in consulting or professional services;

  • Experience in enterprise sales;

  • Fluency in an additional European language (e.g. French, Italian).


    • What we offer

title: Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare, you’ll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run.

In regulated industries, relationships are the currency, so we’re looking for a leader who already knows the buyers and the rulebook. You’ll have the mandate to win net-new logos, drive agent sales, and build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive adoption of ElevenLabs, including closing deals yourself and also building and scaling the team

  • Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

  • Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

  • Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

  • Open doors through your own network of senior buyers, and turn early wins into the references the rest of the vertical will call

  • Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

  • Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

  • Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

  • Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

  • Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

  • Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

  • Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 2 years leading a team.

  • Track record selling into health systems, payers, or life sciences, with deep fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, AI governance, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • An established network of senior decision-makers in one or more of health systems, payers, or life sciences, so you can name the buyers you’d call in your first 30 days

  • Experience building a new sales motion or playbook from scratch, whether as a founding leader or inside a larger company

  • Passion for experimenting to find the positioning and messaging that wins in market, and turn what works into the playbook

  • Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles

  • Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

  • Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

  • Low ego and hands-on: equally at home in a C-suite briefing and in the weeds of a prospecting list or Proof of Value. Motivated by impact and growth more than title

  • Passion for the transformative potential of voice and conversational AI

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

  • Proven practical experience working with vulnerable communities, especially people living with a disability, and ensuring they are provided the time, space and accommodation to be equal partners in high-pressure productions, on tight timelines, and in public.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers

description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

The work spans client delivery and internal accelerator development. You map the problem, structure the solution, and own the outcome from end to end. AI coding agents are central to how we build — not a novelty, but the daily layer that lets a small team cover a lot of ground.

What You'll Do

  • Own work end to end — from discovery and solution shaping through system design, build, and production deployment.

  • Design and build the data foundation: data models, schema design, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD) that hold up in production.

  • Build full-stack applications on top of that foundation — Python/FastAPI services and Next.js frontends that make data and AI workflows usable.

  • Use AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) as a primary build accelerator to move from spec to working software quickly, without sacrificing judgment or quality.

  • Design and build AI capabilities where they fit — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and LLM-in-the-loop processing — and compose them via MCP servers, Skills, and Plugins.

  • Orchestrate pipelines and automation with tools like Airflow, Dagster/Prefect, Celery, or Temporal — choosing the right tool for the job.

  • Stand up and own CI/CD and cloud deployments on AWS and Azure.

  • Translate ambiguous client requirements into clear designs and communicate trade-offs to both technical and business audiences.

  • Contribute reusable accelerators and technical assets back to the Data Practice.

 

Must Have

We're looking for genuine production depth across data engineering and full-stack development — not surface familiarity with either.

Data Engineering Foundation

  • Data modeling and schema design — dimensional modeling, normalization trade-offs, and EDW/warehouse schema design you can defend.

  • Hands-on data pipeline experience — ETL/ELT design across batch and incremental loads, built and maintained in production (not just SQL scripts on a schedule).

  • Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) and change-data handling — knows the patterns and when each applies.

  • dbt Experience— modular SQL transformations, tests, documentation, and incremental strategies.

  • Advanced SQL and at least one modern data platform in depth (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable cloud warehouse/lakehouse).

  • Data quality thinking — testing, validation, and lineage treated as first-class, not afterthoughts.

Full-Stack AI Product Development

  • Python as a primary language — services, automation, and data work alike.

  • FastAPI — async REST API design, dependency injection, testing.

  • A modern frontend, ideally Next.js — component architecture, SSR, state management, and real UX sensibility.

  • PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization, indexing.

  • System design — can architect from a blank page: services, boundaries, trade-offs, and scale.

  • AI-paired engineering — uses an agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable) as a genuine daily workflow accelerator, and can speak concretely to how.

  • CI/CD and cloud deployment ownership on AWS or Azure, without heavy support.

Ways of Working

  • Comfortable in client-facing delivery — can represent TechTorch technically and translate between business and engineering.

  • Customer-first mindset — anchors decisions in what the stakeholder is actually trying to accomplish, and can move fluidly between the engineer's view and the business owner's in the same conversation.

  • End-to-end ownership instinct — takes a problem from discovery to production and owns the outcome, rather than passing it along at each handoff.

Nice to Have

Not required to apply — but these are the things that make a candidate stand out.

Standout differentiator — Commercial data fluency: Experience evaluating how commercial data flows across CRM (ideally Salesforce) and ERP (ideally NetSuite) from opportunity to order to invoice, with the ability to diagnose, document, and resolve inconsistencies.

  • Agentic AI depth — LangGraph or comparable: multi-agent coordination, tool use, memory, and state management.

  • RAG engineering — retrieval strategies, vector stores, chunking, re-ranking, and evaluation.

  • Experience in a consulting or client-delivery environment, or a forward-deployed / embedded engineering role.

  • Workflow orchestration breadth across multiple tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, ADF, Databricks Workflows).

  • Streaming data patterns — Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.

  • Vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector.

  • Experiment tracking — MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar.

  • Contributions to open-source AI or data tooling, or to internal accelerators and frameworks.

  • Multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architecture exposure.

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You're comfortable designing a data model in the morning and shipping a FastAPI + Next.js feature on top of it in the afternoon.

  • You treat an AI coding agent as a force multiplier — you've genuinely changed how you build, not just turned on autocomplete.

  • You can explain an SCD strategy to an engineer and a data-quality risk to a business stakeholder in the same conversation.

  • You've shipped real things in production — not just demos or PoCs.

  • You're opinionated about system and data design, and can back it up.

What We Offer

  • Semi-annual team offsites — we come together in person at least twice a year to connect, recharge, and do the work that's better face-to-face.

  • High-autonomy, high-ownership work across the full arc of real client problems — not toy datasets or boxed-in tickets.

  • Room to grow toward data architecture, platform leadership, or AI engineering depth, depending on where you want to take it.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

  • Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

  • Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

  • Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

  • Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

  • Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

  • Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

title: Product Designer
description:
The Role

 

We're hiring Product Designers to help shape how enterprises understand, govern, and trust their AI agents.

 

Geordie is building category-defining tooling for agent visibility, governance, and risk. The design challenge is real: AI agent behaviour is complex, often opaque, and the stakes for our customers are high.

 

Our design team is small today; you'll report into our Head of Product Design and join two Product Designers. We have three development teams, growing to five, and we believe design works best embedded. You'll join one of those teams as its designer, working alongside its engineers and customers every day. Because we're still early, you'll also help set the foundation everything else is built on: the design language, the component library, and the patterns we use across the product. Our design team also looks after Geordie's brand, so you'll help shape how we show up beyond the product too, making sure brand and product feel like one coherent experience.

 

Design here isn't a layer applied at the end. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. We don't have Product Managers; design and engineering partner directly to figure out what to build. Our engineers are deeply product-minded, close to customers, and want to solve the right problem rather than ship to spec. Together you'll define problems, shape scope, and own outcomes. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 

We also move fast. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 
 
 
 

What You'll Do

 

Own the end-to-end design of core product experiences, from early concept through to shipped and iterated.

 

Help build Geordie's design system with the rest of the design team; the tokens, components, patterns, and documentation that everyone relies on, shaped by what your team needs.

 

Contribute to Geordie's brand; helping evolve our visual language, illustration, and assets so the product and brand tell one story.

 

Lead customer discovery and research; running interviews, identifying patterns, and bringing customer insight into every design decision.

 

Work directly with customers to test your thinking early and close the loop between insight and shipped product.

 

Collaborate daily with engineers; pairing, reviewing, and increasingly using AI tools to prototype and contribute to the codebase yourself.

 

Contribute to product direction: you will be in the room where decisions are made, not handed a spec to execute.

 

Keep a strong point of view on what good design looks like in a security and governance product; clear, trustworthy, and built for expert users.

 
 
 

What We're Looking For

 

The most important thing is that you care deeply about customers and can move fast without losing quality. You are a strong practitioner; you can go from whiteboard to high-fidelity quickly, and you know when each is appropriate.

 

You are comfortable with ambiguity. We are Series A, the product is evolving, and the domain of AI agent governance is genuinely new. You find that energising, not unsettling.

 

You have strong opinions about design systems and component architecture, and experience building or significantly contributing to one. You can articulate why decisions were made and defend them clearly.

 

You work well in a collaborative engineering culture. You are comfortable pair-designing with engineers, reviewing pull requests for design quality, and using AI tools to accelerate your own work.

 
 

Requirements

 

Significant experience as a product designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates complex UX problem-solving; not just polished visuals.

 

Experience designing highly complex B2B SaaS products, including data visualisation and data-dense interfaces; you can turn large volumes of information into something expert users can understand and act on.

 

Proven ability to work across the full design process: research, concept, detailed design, and handoff.

 

Strong product thinking; you can define the problem, question the brief, and help decide what to build, not just how it should look.

 

Strong communication and collaboration skills; you can align stakeholders, present work with clarity, and receive feedback well.

 

Comfortable working in a fast-moving, iterative environment where requirements evolve quickly.

 
 
 

Nice to Haves

 

Experience designing for security, developer, or enterprise SaaS products.

 

Familiarity with AI agent tooling, observability platforms, or data-dense interfaces.

 

Experience contributing to a design system, including tokens, components, and documentation.

 

Experience working on brand or visual identity, such as illustration, iconography, or marketing design.

 

Experience writing code, even basic frontend, or using AI tools to prototype in the browser.

 

Background working at an early-stage startup where you built things from scratch.

 
 
 

Why This Role

 

AI agents are changing how companies operate, and the question of how to govern them safely is only going to grow. Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to answer that question.

 

You will join at a point where design is still being defined. There is no legacy system to work around, no established playbook to follow; just a hard problem, a sharp team, and a genuine opportunity to shape how a new category is understood.

 

You will work with real customers, see the impact of your work quickly, and have the scope to grow as the company does.

 
 

Our Values

 

Solve What Matters

 

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

 

Build, Learn, Iterate

 

We favour momentum over perfection; testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

 

Kind, Not Comfortable

 

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

 

A Platform for Your Best Work

 

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/...

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near our London office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £90,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in the application.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks. See FAQ for detail.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Keith Reid, Head of Product

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

 
 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

 

Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.

That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.

We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.

Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out. Great means that:

  1. the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and

  2. those outcomes show up in revenue.

What you're here to do:

  • Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.

  • Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.

  • It's an agentic flow where "good redline" depends on the customer's playbook rather than any fixed answer, so a lot of the work is deciding what good means with customers and then holding engineering to it. It spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.

  • Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.

Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once.

  • You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped.

  • You've built for users you got to know directly, not through Sales or Customer Success. That means you've sat with them, watched them work and can tell us what they taught you.

  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies.

  • You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.*

  • You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build.

  • You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks.

Bonus if:

  • You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production.

  • Legal tech or contracting experience.

  • You've worked on collaboration or multiplayer editing tools.

*What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful.

  • You'd rather run the process than talk to customers.

  • You think of AI as something the engineers deal with.

  • You treat design as a service that receives your specs. Here you'd decide what to build alongside a designer, not hand it over.

  • You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams.

  • You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it.

  • You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. This is hands-on.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

 
 

GOT MORE QUESTIONS?

 

Check if they're answered on:

  • Our extended job description for this role: https://juro.notion.site/...

  • Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook

  • Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site

 

There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach ----- for anything.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Distributed Systems
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend on Camunda’s Distributed Systems team, you’ll help build and evolve the durable, highly available, horizontally scalable streaming platform that underpins Camunda 8’s Orchestration Cluster and powers mission‑critical processes for customers around the world.

As part of the Distributed Systems team, you will work on technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as expanding on our multi-Raft implementation, our SWIM-based cluster membership algorithm, or high performance network and disk I/O pipelines.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services for the distributed streaming platform that powers the foundation for Camunda 8’s orchestration capabilities, ensuring durability, high availability, and horizontal scalability.

  • Lead medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end‑to‑end: partner with Product to translate business problems into technical requirements, write solution designs, draft and maintain project plans, and drive timely, high‑quality delivery.

  • Help mature our disaster recovery and resilience story, including implementing and evolving an online backup/restore API and contributing to improved multi‑region and multi‑tenant capabilities for our cloud offering.

  • Design and implement developer and operator tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate a complex distributed system in production environments.

  • Improve engineering effectiveness by collaborating with DevOps and other Core Application teams on CI, testing, and local development workflows to reduce PR time‑to‑merge and the overhead of working on multiple features in parallel.

  • Participate in L3 support and on‑call rotations, partnering closely with Support and SRE to investigate and resolve complex, performance‑sensitive production issues, and feeding what you learn back into our product and platform.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and/or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience leading medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (roughly 3+ months), breaking down ambiguous problems, writing clear solution designs and project plans, coordinating with multiple teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Hands‑on experience building and maintaining highly concurrent, data‑intensive software, with a deep understanding of low‑level network and disk I/O (for example, throughput, latency, backpressure, batching, and failure modes).

  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and navigate ambiguity – you are comfortable taking on problems you haven’t solved before, breaking them down into concrete steps, and driving them to completion with minimal supervision.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote‑first environment: you tailor explanations to your audience, translate business requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and help teams reach clear, decisive outcomes with minimal churn.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience with distributed systems algorithms or protocols such as Raft, Paxos, SWIM, and/or CRDTs.

  • Strong familiarity with the observability pillars (logging, metrics, tracing) and how to integrate observability into the development and incident lifecycle, ideally including experience with L3 support and on‑call.

  • Deep knowledge of the Java Virtual Machine, especially its memory model and performance characteristics in highly concurrent, data‑intensive workloads.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

  • United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

  • Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.
