title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations (m/f/x)
description:
Your Role 

As Data Analyst in Operations at FINN, you will be at the heart of driving our business operations through data-driven insights. By leveraging advanced analytics tools and techniques, you will uncover trends, forecast outcomes, and provide actionable recommendations that validate the impact of strategic decisions. This role is perfect for a proactive problem solver who thrives in a data-rich environment. We’ve fully embraced AI-assisted development to amplify our impact, and we’re looking for a teammate who is excited to build and innovate using modern, AI-driven workflows too.


Your Responsibilities
  • Be a Domain Expert: As a domain expert, lead in-depth and advanced analysis of Operations data to uncover actionable insights that elevate performance and drive strategic decisions in areas like logistics, customer service, damage management, and risk assessment.
  • Own the semantics of Operations data: As the authority on Operations metrics, you ensure a unified data language across the domain. By standardizing key terminology, you enable deeper insights and faster decision-making for accelerated growth and improved operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Craft Compelling Narratives: Transform complex data into visually stunning dashboards, reports and appealing data stories that tell a clear status and allow actionable insights.
  • Be a Data Evangelist: Partner with cross-functional business, tech teams and data teams to continuously enhance data processes and tools, ensuring every move is backed by cutting-edge analytics.

    • Your Profile
  • Graduated with a Master’s degree in a quantitative field of study.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in data analytics with a focus on Operations Domain at a scaleup.
  • Advanced SQL modeling with dbt (Data Build Tool).
  • Proficiency in data visualization with Looker (or similar BI tool).
  • Proficiency in applying statistical analysis.
  • Python skills with strong willingness to learn more.
  • Proven experience integrating AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) into your daily analytics workflow to write code, explore data, and ship work.
  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

    • Why FINN?
  • Remote Work: You have the flexibility to work either in our Munich office or remotely in Germany.

  • Shared Success (VSOP Equity Program): We win together. Through our Virtual Stock Option Program, you benefit directly from the long-term growth and success of FINN.

  • Fuel your Growth (3.000€ Development Budget): Standing still is not an option. With your annual development budget for further training and seminars, you decide how you want to grow personally and professionally.

  • Family First (Childcare Subsidy & Flexibility): We support you and your family. Benefit from a monthly childcare subsidy, exclusive access to daycare spots in Munich, and maximum flexibility to balance work and family life stress-free.

  • Company Pension Scheme (bAV): We think about your future. FINN subsidizes your company pension plan with a strong employer contribution of 66%.

  • Experience our Product (25% Car Subscription Discount): Become a FINN driver yourself! You will receive a generous employee discount or can alternatively take advantage of our attractive bike leasing scheme.

  • Health & Mindset (Sports & Wellbeing): Your energy is our drive. Benefit from a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership for fitness and sports, as well as professional mental health support.

  • Munich Office Life: Barista-style coffee, matcha, and a luscious fruit basket await you at our modern headquarters in Munich. On top of that, there is a daily lunch subsidy for those in the office.

  • Team Spirit & Corporate Events: We are more than just colleagues. Whether it's summer events by the lake or simply a relaxed after-work drink, we celebrate our milestones together at regular team events.

    • About Us

    FINN is Germany’s leading car subscription platform and one of the country's few unicorns in the mobility sector. With over 400 colleagues from more than 40 nations, we are building the future of mobility and making access to your own car more seamless than ever before. What truly makes us proud, however, isn’t just the numbers, but what lies behind them: our strong team drive, the will to challenge the status quo, and the ambition to make a real difference. With us, you have the opportunity to take on direct responsibility in one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in Germany and actively shape our success story. We´re just getting started!

    More information: www.finn.com

title: Unbezahltes Praktikum in Hamburger Start-Up | Social Media & Creative Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Lust, eine Marke von Anfang an mitzugestalten? Bei 7 Elements machen wir Elektrolyte ohne Zucker — ohne Bullshit und Füllstoffe, über unseren eigenen Shop verkauft, entwickelt von unserer Gründerin, einer Ärztin. Übernimm unser TikTok und Instagram, arbeite mit Creatorn, dreh eigene Videos und probier aus, was funktioniert. Werde Teil eines kleinen Hamburger Teams mit kurzen Wegen, in dem deine Ideen nicht untergehen, sondern maßgeblich mitgestalten.

Aufgaben

  • TikTok: Du entwickelst Ideen, drehst, schneidest und veröffentlichst. Vom Trend-Hook bis zum eigenen Format.
  • Instagram: Du pflegst Feed und Stories und hältst die Bildsprache konsistent.
  • Influencer und UGC: Du suchst passende Creator, sprichst sie an, betreust die Zusammenarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende Content herauskommt, den wir auch nutzen können.
  • Content-Produktion: Du machst eigene Fotos und Videos — Produkt, Lifestyle, Behind the Scenes.
  • KI-Tools: Wir arbeiten intern mit KI für Bild, Text und Automatisierung. Du nutzt diese Tools aktiv und baust unsere Workflows mit aus.
  • Richtung mitbestimmen: Du bringst eigene Formate und Kanäle ein, testest sie und sagst uns ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.

What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounting Solutions Consultant to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Take features from idea to production, then iterate on real usage.

  • Collaborate directly with client project managers and engineers, learning how they work and sharing your expertise.

  • Keep quality high through testing, monitoring and sensible guardrails.

What we look for

  • Around 2+ years of production engineering experience.

  • Excellent Python and at least one other modern programming language.

  • Genuine curiosity about applied AI and a bias to ship.

  • A clear communicator who enjoys working closely with clients and understands what they need.

  • An appetite for working in an inclusive team, alongside people whose lived experiences may differ from your own.

Our process

Our typical hiring process usually consists of the following stages:

  • Initial screening call

  • Competency-based interview

  • Technical assessment

Note that we may add additional assessment stages if required.

Additional note

A career break or a non-linear route into engineering isn't a blocker here. We hire on what you can do now, not the shape of your CV, and we offer structured ramp-up and mentoring for anyone returning after time out.

Fifty One Degrees is a UK AI and data consultancy, founded in 2023 by Nick and Mark who both built and sold their own companies. Mark Somers (CPO) built 4most into the UK's largest independent credit risk consultancy.

We embed practitioners in client teams and build the best solution that will drive for maximum client value. Strategy, governance and training are also key, but we stay and build rather than hand over a document and leave.

This role combines client-facing consultant and software engineer. You’ll need to fluently read, interpret, write and test production-level code; but you'll also spend time working closely with our clients.

If you want to see how AI actually lands inside a business and unlocks value, this is the role for you.

 

How we work

Small teams, real ownership, no layer of middle management between you and the client or the founders. You're trusted with real work from week one, combined with the right level of support. We pair, we share what we learn, and we're honest about what's working and what isn't.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

title: Software Engineer - BrandX
description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘BrandX’ team, which is part of the wider ‘Order Engineering’ group.

BrandX (Brand Experience) builds the tools restaurant brands and Olo's internal teams use to run their business on Olo. We own the Dashboard that brand operators log into every day, the internal Admin application, and the billing and invoicing systems that turn platform usage into invoices. We also own how brands sign in and manage their users, including SSO and two-factor authentication, and we are building Olo AI Assist, a natural-language assistant inside the Dashboard.

The team is seven engineers spread across the US and Europe, and you'd be our first hire in Northern Ireland. Because the team sits between brands, Finance, and the rest of Order Engineering, the work is varied. One week you might be shipping a new Dashboard settings page, the next you're tracing a billing discrepancy across our finance integrations or teaching Olo AI Assist a new skill so a brand can update hours across hundreds of stores just by asking. You'll pair with senior engineers, review and ship code most days, and use Claude Code as a normal part of how you work.


How you’ll make an impact

  • Learn the BrandX domain and technology stack, and get to know the brands, Finance partners, and Order Engineering teams we work with.

  • Own small-to-medium features end to end, from understanding the requirement to shipping it, with senior engineers available when you need them.

  • Write code that meets our standards, and participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer.

  • Build reliable and maintainable software, with test coverage that matches the risk of the change.

  • Contribute to the team’s delivery pipeline, including test coverage, CI, and deployment practices.

  • Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as your default way of building, and help the team push what these tools can do.

  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, learning how our systems fit together along the way.

  • Participate in team ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and retrospectives, sharing updates and feedback.

  • Take part in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with Olo’s tools and processes.

  • Join the on-call rotation, with responsibilities that grow as you learn the team’s systems.


    • What will set you up for success

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects.

  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET, and comfort reading code you didn't write.

  • Some experience building web UIs. We use React and TypeScript, but any modern framework is a fine starting point.

  • Comfortable with SQL and relational data. A lot of our work is understanding how data moves between systems.

  • You understand the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and when each one earns its place.

  • AI coding agents are your default way of working. You use tools like Claude Code daily, you can explain the fundamentals underneath what they generate, and you're excited about a team that expects you to push them further. 

  • You ask questions early, write things down, and are comfortable working with colleagues in other time zones.

    • About Olo

    Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at olo.com.

title: Growth Manager

Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

Growth at Yubo moves fast, and we don’t plan on stopping anytime soon ! More channels, more markets, more experiments to run, and we need brains (and hands…) to make it happen. We're bringing in a third Growth Manager to grow the team's capacity and add a perspective on Gen Z that comes from living it, being molded by it.

Sounds like you? You’ll like what comes next.

We’ll get you started by getting hands-on with every channel we operate, learning how each and every single one of them works before claiming your own piece of the portfolio. From there, a whole new world of possibilities opens up: push creative testing further, chase down new partners, help us uncover growth where we haven't looked yet, and more.

You'll work shoulder to shoulder with the rest of the Growth team (that includes Creative), Product, and Data, all pulling in the same direction. If you want a role where your instincts, ideas, and results speak for themselves, this is it.

Your responsibilites

  • User Acquisition & Paid Media Optimization: Manage and optimize a significant performance marketing budget across key acquisitoin channels, programmatic networks & emerging platforms. Scale acquisition and reactivation across multiple countries. Improve media buying, targeting, and creative to boost ROAS, using incrementality tests and attribution models. Help deploy automation and AI tools.

  • Creative Optimization: Collaborate with the creative team to ideate, produce and scale creative concepts that resonate with our Gen Z audience. Own creative testing and iteration to improve the scale, efficiency and longevity of winning ideas.

  • Growth Marketing: Support a multi-channel strategy that combines paid and brand marketing to drive organic, viral and referral loops. Contribute to ASO and lifecycle marketing to boost retention and monetization.

  • Data-Driven Growth: Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to optimize funnels. Build dashboards and A/B testing processes. Stay ahead of privacy and adtech trends (e.g SKAN, AdAttributionKit).

  • Collaboration: Work with senior growth team members, share best practices, and foster a culture of experimentation and data-driven decisions.

Tools we use

  • MMP: Adjust

  • Market intelligence: Sensor Tower and Creative Ad Libraries

  • Acquisition channels: TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Google Ads, Apple Ads

  • Programmatic networks: AppLovin, Moloco

Who you are

  • You have around 3 years of solid, consolidated experience in growth marketing or user acquisition for a B2C consumer app.

  • You have a genuine, native affinity with Gen Z culture and what makes it tick.

  • You have experience or a strong connection with the US market, whether through studies or product marketing experience.

  • You've scaled growth investment on at least one major social media platform and know how to read the results.

  • You know how to collaborate with creative teams: identifying what works, and clearly explaining why.

  • You have experience working with a martech stack, including custom audiences, conversion APIs, and MMP & SDK implementations and updates.

  • You're autonomous, result-oriented, and bring strong business acumen to your decisions.

Within a month, you will

  • Get to know Yubo's product, mission, and the Growth team's ways of working.

  • Meet your key stakeholders across Growth, Creative, Product, and Data.

  • Get onboarded on our tools and marketing stack, including Adjust, Amplitude and more

  • Start learning how each of our acquisition channels currently operates.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Fully own a portfolio of channels and campaigns to optimise in line with our performance guidelines

  • Work to automate campaign and creative optimisation process

  • Improve our usage of custom audience strategies across all channels

Within 6 months, you will

  • Scale your portfolio to reach our strategic growth objectives

  • Seek opportunities to further improve our growth operations by deploying AI tools

  • Assist in developing our retargeting workflows for a more diversified approach

The recruitment process

  • First call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

  • An interview with Janos, our Growth Director

  • Technical test / case study.

  • Fit interviews

  • And if everything goes well, an offer !

What we offer

  • A highly flexible remote work policy, 2 days at the office per month, with monthly team events.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

title: Social Creative Director
description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Capability Overview

In Jellyfish Creative, we embed Gen AI at our core to create, adapt, connect and optimise award-winning content at scale. In 150+ markets. For the world’s leading brands. Our creative model combines tech-driven ideation with human-generated social creativity, connecting all 400 creative and experienced experts across the globe, powered by the integration of Pencil Pro. AI Studios is where creative talent supercharges Jellyfish’s market-leading experience in content, production, transcreation and localisation generating content at scale and our most dynamic, diverse, and inspiring talent forms the award-winning Creative Collective, focusing on human-generated social creative with cultural relevance that can live on any platform or medium. Creating end-to-end solutions that bring audience expectations and platform algorithms together with relevance, clarity and cultural resonance.

Job Description

The Senior Creative, Social is a hands-on conceptual thinker and maker who can bridge the worlds of advertising and social. You’ll be as comfortable cracking a big campaign platform, activation or experiential idea as you are creating culturally relevant, platform-native social work. We’re looking for someone who understands that the best social ideas aren’t simply content, they’re ideas people want to talk about, participate in and share.

Working closely with our Creative Directors and wider creative teams, you’ll develop ideas from first thought through to execution, helping us create work that moves seamlessly between campaigns, activations, content and culture. This is a role for someone ambitious about the work. Someone with a strong conceptual advertising brain, a deep understanding of social platforms and culture, and a portfolio that demonstrates both. We want to see evidence of award-winning ideas, not just beautifully executed content.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our London office. The salary range for this position is between £70,000-78,000 GBP, annually, and a final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

Conceptual & Social Creativity

  • Develop bold, original ideas across social, campaigns, activations, experiential, digital and emerging platforms.

  • Bring the same conceptual ambition to a TikTok, Reel or reactive social opportunity as you would to a major integrated campaign brief.

  • Think beyond posts and content calendars to create social ideas that can earn attention, conversation and cultural relevance.

  • Turn cultural observations, audience behaviours, platform trends and brand truths into simple, powerful creative ideas.

  • Understand the difference between following culture and contributing to it, and constantly look for opportunities for our brands to do the latter.

  • Create ideas that can start in social and grow into something bigger, as well as finding compelling social expressions of larger campaign platforms.

  • Bring an award-winning mentality to briefs of every size, continually pushing the work beyond the expected.

  • Work closely with Creative Directors to develop, challenge and elevate ideas from initial concept through to final execution.

Leadership & Creative Culture

  • Mentor and inspire junior creatives, designers and content creators, helping them strengthen both their conceptual thinking and social craft.

  • Give clear, constructive feedback that makes ideas stronger rather than simply different.

  • Help build a creative culture that is ambitious, collaborative, curious and relentlessly focused on the quality of the work.

Social & Cultural Fluency

  • Stay obsessively curious about internet culture, entertainment, technology, creators, memes, trends and emerging behaviours.

  • Understand platform conventions without becoming constrained by them.

  • Bring a strong point of view on what makes work genuinely social rather than simply advertising placed on social platforms.

  • Help educate clients and internal teams on evolving social behaviours, creative opportunities and emerging formats.

Creative Craft & Making

  • Take ideas from blank page through to execution, including concepts, scripts, social formats, treatments, storyboards, copy, creator briefs and presentations.

  • Use GenAI and emerging creative technologies as genuine creative tools to explore, prototype, make and push ideas further rather than simply make things faster.

  • Be comfortable making and prototyping ideas yourself when it helps bring thinking to life quickly.

  • Work closely with creators, designers, writers, editors, producers and production partners to maintain the integrity of an idea throughout production.

  • Understand how craft changes by platform, audience and context without compromising the strength of the underlying idea.

  • Continually experiment with new tools, formats and production approaches that could unlock new creative possibilities.

  • Bring innovation (particularly AI and emerging technologies) into both the thinking and making of our work.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years within advertising, social or creative agencies, with experience operating at Senior Creative level.

  • A conceptual creative first with a strong advertising brain and can reduce a complicated brief to a simple, powerful idea.

  • You are socially fluent and understand platforms, creators, communities, formats and internet culture deeply enough to create work that belongs there.

  • Experience moving comfortably between campaign platforms, activations and experiential ideas and fast-moving, culturally relevant social content.

  • Deep understanding of how people actually use TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit and emerging social platforms, including the behaviours, communities, creators and formats that shape them.

  • You have created, or can demonstrate the potential to create, work capable of competing at the highest creative level.

  • Experience with the nuanced rules and behaviours of individual platforms but don't allow formats or trends to become substitutes for ideas.

  • Ability to articulate ideas simply, write compelling copy and scripts, and build persuasive creative presentations.

  • Strong presentation experience with the ability to sell an idea, defend the thinking behind it and bring clients and collaborators with you.

  • Experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Kling and other emerging creative technologies as part of your creative process.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Join us in building the AI layer for Observability!

ClickStack is the open-source observability platform we're building at ClickHouse — logs, metrics, traces, and session replays unified so engineers can find root causes quickly. The interesting work now is in the agent layer: systems that can investigate an incident at 2 AM, propose a root cause, and hand the on-call a concise summary by the time they've logged in.

We're hiring an AI Product Engineer to build agentic capabilities on top of a petabyte-scale observability platform, with a focus on developer experience. If you've been building agents, designing skills, and wiring up MCP servers — and you've hit the limits of generic copilots for production work — we'd like to talk.

What you'll do

  • Build agents that investigate incidents. They surface anomalies, answer "why is production broken?", and use ClickStack as their substrate.

  • Write skills, not just prompts. Build a library of reusable skills that captures how our team debugs, finds root causes, writes ClickHouse queries, and runs incident response, so agents pick up the right playbook instead of starting from scratch.

  • Own the agent stack end-to-end. Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production.

  • Make ClickStack a great place to run AI workloads. Build the MCP servers, SDKs, and integrations that let customers' agents read telemetry, take action, and stay observable themselves.

  • Work in the open. Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product.

  • Tackle the hard parts. Latency, cost, context window limits, eval coverage, hallucinations on real telemetry.


Who you are

  • You've been building agents long enough to have opinions — about context engineering, tool design, when to use a skill vs. a tool, what evals catch and miss, and where popular frameworks break down.

  • You think in production terms: p99 latency, cost per task, whether the system still works next week without intervention.

  • You move quickly, ship often, and learn from what breaks.

  • You care about developer tools and have a clear sense of what good DX looks like.

  • You do well with ambiguity and ownership.

What you bring

  • Strong backend skills in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python. Comfortable in both, even if one is primary.

  • Hands-on experience building agents: multi-step tool use, planning, memory, error recovery. You've shipped them and dealt with the failure modes.

  • Experience designing skills (Markdown-based workflow encodings, Anthropic-style or similar) and a clear view on when a skill, a tool, or both is the right fit.

  • Experience with MCP: building servers, designing tools, and thinking through auth, scoping, and observability for agentic systems.

  • Strong evals practice: golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression detection.

  • SQL proficiency — you can write ClickHouse queries directly.

  • Comfort with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Active in open source and the developer community.

Bonus

  • Built or operated production agents in observability, incident response, or SRE.

  • Strong opinions on agent observability — tracing, cost attribution, eval pipelines, OpenTelemetry for agents — and ideas on how to improve it.

  • Experience with prompt caching, context compaction, or other techniques relevant to running agents on production telemetry volumes.

  • Experience with columnar databases and event ingestion pipelines.

description:
About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal

This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead

Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge

Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:

  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.

We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do

You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:

  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
  • Be a generally awesome person.

What We're Looking For

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have

  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
  • AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.

You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year:

  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
  • Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
  • We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
  • You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.

Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.

We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

Why Join SchemeServe?

  • Fully remote UK-based role.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats.
  • Flexible working.
  • Dedicated professional development support.
  • Paid charity days.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. Du bekommst spannende Daten aus vielen unterschiedlichen Kundenprojekten und viel Gestaltungsspielraum, weil du bei uns Strukturen mit aufbaust statt nur zu verwalten. Unsere Wege sind kurz, Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Dazu kommt ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, und ein Arbeitgeber, der wächst.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

 

About the role

Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback.

We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

 

Solutions Engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed.

  • Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms.

  • Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions.

  • Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience.

  • Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements.

  • Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver.

  • Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time

 

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

 

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Remote pair programming

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

description:
Grow with Treefera

We are a first-mile intelligence platform, delivering granular visibility into the point of origin in global ag & soft commodity supply chains - where risk, cost, performance and exposure are set.

You’ll join a global, cross-functional team that values rigour, curiosity and working close to real-world challenges. Whether your focus is AI, climate, product or operations, you’ll have space to contribute meaningfully and make an impact from day one.

If you’re excited by complex problems and want to help reshape how nature is valued in real-world decision-making, we’d love to hear from you.

Role overview

Build the systems behind Treefera's Environmental Intelligence — the data models, pipelines and APIs that turn satellite and ground-truth signals into evidence customers can act on, fast enough to change a decision.

Who you are

  • You have taken a production Python service or pipeline through a significant change to its architecture — a re-model, a re-platform, or a rewrite of how data moves through it.

  • You design the data models and APIs other people build on, and you have lived with the consequences of your own schema decisions.

  • You work from a problem rather than a ticket: you pick the approach, make the call on the trade-offs, and can explain the reasoning afterwards.

  • You extend systems that already exist — including the parts nobody wants to touch — rather than reaching for a rewrite.

  • You use AI in your workflow, or are ready to, and you can explain what you kept, what you threw away, and why.

Desirable requirements (if applicable):

  • Geospatial or Earth Observation data — GIS, remote sensing, or Postgres and PostGIS.

  • Scientific Python such as NumPy, GeoPandas or Xarray, or pipeline orchestration with Dagster.

  • Some familiarity with Typescript, React or NestJS — you will touch the app occasionally rather than daily.

What the job involves

  • Ship services end to end — data model, pipeline, API — from a question a customer asked to something that answers it.

  • Turn emerging ideas into working prototypes quickly, so customer feedback arrives in weeks rather than quarters.

  • Own the technical decisions in your scope — extending Treefera's existing platform and its constraints, refactoring where it pays and resisting the rewrite where it doesn't.

  • Carry work past release through maintenance, documentation and operational follow-through, so what ships stays reliable.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll monitor live system health using logs, metrics, traces, alerts and reliability dashboards, identifying issues before they affect operations. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. Are you ready to join us?

Your focus: implement models and algorithms to optimize fees and pricing.

What You’ll do

  • Drive pricing intelligence: design and implement Machine Learning models and optimization algorithms that directly fuel a comprehensive suite of pricing levers

  • Own projects end to end: from problem definition and metrics design, through data extraction and model implementation, to presenting results to business and product stakeholders.

About you

  • At least 5 years of industry experience as a data scientist and Master’s (or PhD ) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics or Engineering

  • Impact-driven: You’ve contributed to data science projects that made a real impact on live, customer-facing products — not just in theory, but in production.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you are able to make decisions and propose directions even when the problem is not fully defined or the data is imperfect

  • Strong grasp of machine learning and statistical concepts and know how to choose the right model for the problem and make it work in a production environment.

  • Practical expertise in experimentation design and analysis.

  • Proficient in Python and SQL, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews, and deployment

  • Clear communicator: You are comfortable explaining complex ideas and results to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Recruitment process

title: ADAS Feature Engineer, App SW
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Feature Engineering Team

We’re seeking an exceptional Feature Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

We are looking for an ADAS Feature Engineer to help build the application-layer software that connects Wayve’s AI capabilities to real vehicle behaviour. This role sits at the intersection of AI, vehicle systems, active safety, and product delivery: you will develop C++ feature logic, validation tools, and system behaviours that allow AI-native driving technology to operate robustly in real-world vehicle environments. You will work closely with machine learning, product, vehicle integration, and systems teams to turn model outputs and vehicle data into reliable, testable, and customer-relevant ADAS features.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Design, implement, and maintain C++ application software for ADAS and active-safety-related vehicle features.

  • Build feature-level logic on top of AI / ML outputs, including validation, feasibility checks, state machines, fallback behaviours, and safety-aware decision logic.

  • Work with ML engineers to understand model outputs, limitations, failure modes, and how these translate into vehicle behaviour.

  • Use logs, simulation, replay, and vehicle testing to debug, tune, and validate feature behaviour.

  • Define and improve metrics, test cases, and validation strategies for ADAS feature performance, robustness, and quality.

  • Collaborate with product, systems, vehicle integration, and OEM-facing teams to translate requirements and real-world constraints into engineering solutions.

  • Support field testing and iterative development, including investigation of vehicle issues, edge cases, and performance gaps.

  • Contribute to software architecture, code quality, tooling, and engineering practices for feature development.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

  • Strong C++ software engineering experience, ideally in production or safety-relevant systems.

  • Hands-on experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, robotics, vehicle software, active safety, or closely related domains.

  • Practical understanding of vehicle feature development, including real-world testing, simulation, replay, logs, or prototype vehicle debugging.

  • Ability to reason about vehicle behaviour, sensor/model inputs, timing, failure modes, and feature-level decision logic.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as ML, perception, planning, controls, vehicle integration, product, or systems engineering.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic engineering trade-offs under ambiguity.

  • A quality mindset, with experience writing testable, maintainable software and using data to validate behaviour.

Desirable

  • Experience with ADAS features such as AEB, ISA, AES, ACC, lane keeping, collision avoidance, trajectory validation, or active safety systems.

  • Experience at an automotive OEM, Tier 1 supplier, autonomous driving company, robotics company, or vehicle technology startup.

  • Familiarity with ML or AI-based autonomy systems, including how model outputs are consumed by downstream software.

  • Experience with ROS, Linux, Bazel, CMake, Docker, QNX, protobuf, MCAP, CAN, calibration, or vehicle logging systems.

  • Experience with vehicle test tracks, public-road testing, HIL/SIL, scenario-based testing, or NCAP-style validation.

  • Familiarity with tools used in automotive development and testing, such as CANoe, Vector tools, MicroAutoBox, or similar.

 
 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen: general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.

  • Competency Interviews: programming and code review.

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: domain knowledge & system design.

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
description:
About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

  • Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

  • Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

  • Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

  • Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

  • Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

  • Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

  • Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

  • Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

     

An ideal candidate has

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

  • Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

  • Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

  • The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

  • Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

  • Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

  • A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

  • Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the employee for a group insurance plan through Vitality Health

  • Automatic contributions when you start with Hopper through Smart Pension

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams with massive impact

About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to see millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America, and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.
